title: Multi-label Categorization of Accounts of Sexism using a Neural Framework
benchmark_measurement: Detection of 'Religion-based sexism', defined as sexist discrimination or prejudices stemming from religious scriptures or constructs.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings for the 'Religion-based sexism' category. The performance metrics are aggregated across all categories of sexism.
